business_summary: Univance Corporation manufactures and sells drivetrain components and assemblies for automotive parts and transmissions for industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company provides motor/generator gearboxes for commercial trucks, transfer cases and transmissions for longitudinal engine layouts, transmissions and reduction units for heavy duty tractors, gearboxes for crawlers and concrete mixers, drive force distribution devices, and reduction gears for e-Axles. It also offers CVT components, including pulleys, input shafts, sun gears, planetary carriers, and sub-assemblies; AT components, including turbine hubs, input shafts, planetary carriers, stator assemblies, and one-way clutch components; transmission gears; companion flanges, side shafts, pinion shafts; steering and intermediate gearboxes; clutches for automatic transmissions; and engine gears. In addition, the company provides functional plating, factory-related, logistics, and sales and market research services. Univance Corporation was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Kosai, Japan.
